## Problem Description

A clear description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing.
Example: "I find it difficult to ... because ..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible about the expected behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered and why they are insufficient.

## Affected Components

Which part(s) of MyMail does this relate to? Check all that apply:

- [ ] Stalwart (mail server / SMTP / IMAP / JMAP)
- [ ] Rspamd (spam filtering)
- [ ] Caddy (reverse proxy / TLS)
- [ ] Roundcube (webmail)
- [ ] Admin UI (SvelteKit dashboard)
- [ ] Setup wizard
- [ ] Backup / restore scripts
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, references, or examples that support the request.
